description.value: B House is an Asian fusion eatery on Vancouver's lively Commercial Drive, blending Eastern and Western culinary traditions across an all-day menu that spans brunch, lunch, dinner, and happy hour snacks. The restaurant emphasizes fresh local ingredients, contemporary presentation, and a guest-first philosophy, with reservations available and walk-ins welcome. Its location on one of Vancouver's most walkable and cyclist-friendly strips makes it a natural rest stop on a Commercial Drive touring route.
